title: Usagi Drop Specials
synopsis:
Happa no Suizokukan
One morning, Daikichi Kawachi finds Rin Kaga eagerly crafting fish out of autumn leaves. Wanting to spur her newfound interest, Daikichi helps Rin learn more about the beautiful and diverse animals that live under the sea.

Santa-san e
Spending their first Christmas together, Daikichi and Rin prepare to welcome Santa Claus and his reindeer.

Osora ni Mankai
With the cherry blossoms in full bloom, Rin wants to go flower watching the next day with Daikichi alongside Kouki and Yukari Nitani. However, the forecast of a spring storm may dampen their plans.

Kaeri Michi
After their visit to a summer festival, Kouki is still energetic and wishes to look around more. Daikichi decides to take the group on a quick detour before heading home.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: The Bellflower Girl
episodes_data.description: 30-year-old bachelor businessman Kawachi Daikichi encounters Rin, a girl he`s never seen before, at his grandfather`s funeral. Surprisingly, the 6-year-old girl turns out to be his grandfather`s love child. Daikichi doesn`t like children, but the cold attitude of his relatives towards Rin makes him uncomfortable. And then, the relatives` meeting to decide who will have custody of Rin begins at last...

episodes_data.title: Pinky Promise
episodes_data.description: What kind of clothes to buy her? What to feed her? What to do about nursery school? Daikichi`s new life raising a 6-year-old girl is an uninterrupted stream of bewilderment. Rin looks anxious on her first day of nursery school, so Daikichi does a "pinky swear" with her, promising to pick her up as soon as he can. And Daikichi, who has no confidence he can live with Rin for long, starts thinking about meeting Rin`s mother...

episodes_data.title: Daikichi's Decision
episodes_data.description: Daikichi goes back to his parents’ house with Rin in tow in order to search for clues about her mother. At first, his parents were opposed to him taking custody of the girl, but now they’re not entirely dissatisfied about having what amounts to a grandchild. And at Souichi’s house, Daikichi discovers a mystery modem. This leads him to think about his life with Rin and he makes an important decision.

episodes_data.title: Letter
episodes_data.description: Rin befriends Kouki, a boy she met at the local nursery school, while Daikichi`s pulse races a bit when he meets Kouki`s beautiful single mother. Later, the modem Daikichi discovered at Souichi`s house leads him to his grandfather`s last words. And from there, he receives a contact number for Rin`s mother, Masako...

episodes_data.title: Daikichi is my Daikichi
episodes_data.description: Daikichi finally meets Rin`s mother, Masako, and he`s shocked by her frankness. When they part, Masako asks Daikichi for a favor, and it`s an issue that Daikichi can`t avoid, as long as he`s going to raise Rin. Daikichi tries to resolve it by having a heart-to-heart conversation with Rin, but he gets an unexpected answer...

episodes_data.title: My Tree
episodes_data.description: When Rin enters elementary school, Daikichi proposes planting a tree to commemorate the occasion. Rin plants a loquat seed in the yard, but there`s no telling whether it will actually put forth buds. Thinking that perhaps Souichi planted something to mark Rin`s birth, Daikichi has another visit with Masako...

episodes_data.title: Secretly Running Away From Home
episodes_data.description: Daikichi`s cousin, Haruko, runs away from home to DaikichiÂ`s house with her daughter Reina in tow. Daikichi can hardly fathom Haruko`s determination, but when he does learn her reasons, he`s not a little surprised by how strong Haruko has become as a mother. It gets him thinking again about what marriage and family mean.

episodes_data.title: Grandpa's Precious Thing
episodes_data.description: During Rin`s summer vacation, Daikichi and Rin visit Souichi`s grave, where they find an ink bottle and bellflowers. Daikichi runs after Masako, Rin`s mother, who had just been there, and when he catches up, offers her an unusual proposal.

episodes_data.title: A Typhoon Came!
episodes_data.description: At school, Rin is concerned that the disobedient Kouki is getting off track and getting a bad reputation. Meanwhile, when a typhoon hits, Kouki and his mom take shelter with Daikichi and Rin at their house.

episodes_data.title: Stomach Flu
episodes_data.description: Daikichi feels helpless when Rin is laid up with stomach flu, so Kouki`s mother steps in to give them both a hand.

episodes_data.title: The First Step
episodes_data.description: It`s the first anniversary of Grandpa`s death, which means Rin and Daikichi have been living together for about a year now. Daikichi mulls over what he`s lost and what he`s gained since Rin came into his life…

specials_data.title: Full Bloom in the Sky
specials_data.description: As the cherry trees are in full blossom, Rin wants to go flower watching, and Kouki`s mother prepares a bentou for this purpose. But the weather forecast announced a spring storm, so Rin and Daikichi make good-weather charms.

specials_data.title: The Way Back Home
specials_data.description: After visiting a festival, Kouki is still not tired, so Daikichi suggests a little detour on their way home, thus showing Rin, Kouki and Yukari his "secret place".
